# Slot tables of the WinRT interfaces the 0.10.4 host fakes (GENERATED by tools/arm32/gen_0104_iids.py - do not edit)

Source: Windows SDK winrt WinRT headers (vtable order = declaration order). All slots in `tools/arm32/gen_0104_iids.py` CHECKS were compared with the verified
facts of the 0.10.4 exe: identical. ABI (AAPCS-VFP, Thumb-2): `this` is r0, `HRESULT` returned in r0; `HSTRING` is a pointer; `boolean`/`BYTE` travel in a 32-bit register
(zero-extended); `LONGLONG` (TimeSpan, EventRegistrationToken, INT64) is an 8-byte aligned pair (r2:r3 right after `this`, because r1 is skipped); `double` goes in
d0..; `float` in s0..; enums are `int`. STRUCTS: as OUTPUT parameters (`Size* value`) they travel through POINTERS (`X104Size {float Width,Height}`, `X104Point {float X,Y}`,
`X104Rect {float X,Y,Width,Height}`); as INPUT parameters WinRT passes them BY VALUE (`Measure(Size)`, `Arrange(Rect)`, `put_RenderTransformOrigin(Point)`, `put_PointerPosition(Point)`):
under AAPCS-VFP an all-float struct is a homogeneous aggregate and goes in s0..s3 (declare the C parameter as the struct and the compiler does it). `void *` stands for an interface
pointer (`void **` = `IFoo**`). **Every slot has a typedef `X104_FN_<Interface>_<Method>` (generated into the iids file with exactly the C signature below) and a unit MUST register its
thunk with `X104_SLOT(Interface, Method, thunk)`**: the build refuses a thunk whose signature differs (a missing `LONGLONG`, `float` instead of `double`, `int` instead of `BYTE *` ...).
Slots whose parameters the generator cannot express (struct by value other than Size/Point/Rect) have NO typedef: X104_SLOT does not compile for them (extend the generator). A slot
that deliberately ignores all its arguments is registered with `X104_SLOT_NOARGS(Interface, Method, x104_nop)`. Slot numbers are the vtable index (IUnknown 0-2, IInspectable 3-5 for
`IInspectable`-based interfaces).
